description: Convert a Brazilian household measure (e.g. 2 colheres de sopa, 1 unidade, 1 fatia) of a TACO food to grams, using the IBGE POF table through a hand-curated mapping. Only some foods are covered; it never guesses: on ambiguity it returns candidates, and for uncovered foods or measures it says so. Pass food_id (from search_food) or food_query.

food_id.description: TACO food number, as returned by search_food. Preferred over food_query.

food_query.description: Food name in Portuguese, used only when food_id is not given; must match exactly one food.

measure.description: Household measure in Portuguese, e.g. "colher de sopa", "unidade", "fatia", "concha", "copo americano".

quantity.description: How many of the measure (default 1; may be fractional, e.g. 0.5).

name: convert_household_measure

available_measures.description: Measures known for this food (status unknown_measure).

grams.description: Weight of one measure in grams.

candidates.description: Foods matching the query (status ambiguous_food), best first.

has_household_measures.description: Whether this food can be converted.

name.description: Food name exactly as in the TACO table.

food.description: The resolved food (not set for ambiguous_food / no_food_match).

name.description: Food name exactly as in the TACO table.

grams_per_measure.description: Weight of one measure in grams (status ok).

household_source.description: Citation for the household measure weights.

source_description.description: Description of the POF row the weight comes from.

quantity.description: How many of the measure (status ok).

status.description: ok: grams computed. ambiguous_food: the query matched several foods, pick an id from candidates. no_food_match: no food found. no_household_data: this food has no curated household measures, ask for grams. unknown_measure: use one of available_measures.

title: Convert a household measure to grams
